review_notes: I read the whole file, with the helper definitions it relies on in TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/TensorPower/Basic.lean. I searched Mathlib for coderivation, co-Leibniz, deconcatenation, tensor coalgebra and cofree coalgebra concepts and found none. The file's own definitions are IsCoderivation, coderiv, coderivSummand, coderivations, coderivEquivTaylor and LinearMap.taylorComponent. They are specific to the reduced deconcatenation coalgebra, and Mathlib has no counterparts. The file already uses Mathlib's TensorPower.mulEquiv, TensorPower.cast, PiTensorProduct.tprod, Submodule and LinearEquiv. The sibling TauCeti.TensorPower.oneEquiv is a thin wrapper around PiTensorProduct.subsingletonEquiv. It sits outside this file, and it is a convenience wrapper rather than a duplicate. IsCoderivation could in principle be expressed with Mathlib's Coalgebra, but the reduced deconcatenation is non-counital, so no Mathlib structure fits. I could not run Lean, so uncertainty is limited to Mathlib concepts I may have missed under other names.
